responsibilities: Engage closely with Engineers, Scientists, and Data Engineers on developing BI and analytics solutions to support customer-facing CS products
Support A/B experiment feature testing and analysis
Build and analyze key metrics to uncover trends and root causes of issues
Own the design, development, and maintenance of ongoing data pipelines, metrics, reports, visualizations, analyses, and dashboards to drive business decisions
Help define requirements around customer service interactions and establish actionable insights

Apply generative AI tools and techniques (such as LLM-based summarization, natural language querying, and automated insight generation) to improve analytics productivity and stakeholder self-service capabilities
Partner with cross-functional teams to instrument new data collection, close measurement gaps, and build unified views of customer journeys across products and channels

evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: enable us to rapidly adapt in a dynamic environment
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: The only pace or quality language is "rapidly adapt in a dynamic environment"; the JD has no data quality, testing or governance signal.
evidence.domain_risk: measuring and improving every customer service interaction across chat, voice, bots, and digital self-service
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: Customer service analytics informs planning and product decisions with no financial-reporting or regulatory framing, so it is moderate.
evidence.collaboration_width: Engineers; Scientists; Data Engineers; product teams
evidence.data_team_maturity: You will join a team of data engineers, BIEs, and analysts who own the full analytics lifecycle for CXP
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: An established team of several data roles owning "the full analytics lifecycle" from ingestion to VP-level dashboards is mature.
evidence.jd_authorship: Apply generative AI tools and techniques (such as LLM-based summarization, natural language querying, and automated insight generation)
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Some bullets are specific (LLM summarization, A/B feature testing, instrumenting data collection) and others generic ("Build and analyze key metrics to uncover trends").
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: developing BI and analytics solutions to support customer-facing CS products
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The work serves customer service products and experiments, with "customer-facing CS products" as the anchor.
evidence.autonomy_level: Own the design, development, and maintenance of ongoing data pipelines
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: The role owns its pipelines and metrics but also does "Support A/B experiment feature testing" and "Help define requirements", so it is mixed.
evidence.ai_role: Apply generative AI tools and techniques (such as LLM-based summarization, natural language querying, and automated insight generation) to improve analytics productivity and stakeholder self-service capabilities
evidence.ai_role_explanation: The candidate builds natural language querying and automated insight generation for stakeholders, which makes them an enabler as well as a user.
evidence.testing_framing: No testing or data quality signal.
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: "A/B experiment feature testing" is product experimentation, and the JD has no data testing or data quality language.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: The JD is framed around insight and product improvement with no risk or reliability language.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: instrument new data collection, close measurement gaps, and build unified views of customer journeys
